description: Mint a SHORT link that carries a whole UTM set — cushy.link/t/comm rather than a 130-character tagged URL nobody can paste into a post or read out on a call. Use this whenever the seller is about to share a link anywhere that isn't a paid ad: an email, a community post, a video description, a podcast, an affiliate. Meta and Google attach their own click ids, but every other channel arrives untagged and is reported as 'direct' FOREVER — it cannot be fixed after the fact, because the information was never recorded. Tags are normalised server-side, so use plain words and don't hand-format them. Keep utm_campaign identical across one push and vary utm_content per message, or they can't be compared later. Codes are short and memorable on purpose; the call fails if one is taken.
